description: This file is a test script for Git's HTTP backend, specifically testing the handling of CONTENT_LENGTH and related HTTP behaviors. It includes setup routines, environment configurations, and multiple test cases to verify correct server responses under various conditions.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response status and error messages for HTTP backend responses.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up the environment and invokes the HTTP backend with specified request body and handler type.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Returns a string representing a size larger than size_t's maximum value, for testing overflow handling.
